meta.name: frontend-design
meta.description: Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. Helps with aesthetic direction, typography, and making choices that don't read as templated defaults.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打造有辨识度的界面视觉风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在设计新界面或优化现有视觉风格
copy.tagline_en: Craft distinctive visual styles for your UI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing a new UI or refining an existing visual style

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像一位资深设计总监，帮你构思独特的视觉风格，包括配色、字体、布局，并确保设计不显得模板化。它会先制定设计计划，自我审查，再生成代码。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 设计新界面或改造现有界面时触发，尤其是当你提到需要“独特”、“有辨识度”的设计时。

say.text: 帮我设计一个个人作品集网站的首页，要独特且有风格。
say.note: Claude 会先制定设计计划，然后生成代码。

say.text: 这个登录页面看起来太普通了，帮我重新设计，让它更有辨识度。
say.note: Claude 会分析现有设计并提出改进方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as a design lead, helping you create distinctive visual designs for UI, including color, typography, and layout, avoiding templated defaults. It plans, self-critiques, then generates code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to design a new UI or redesign an existing one, especially when you mention needing a unique or distinctive look.

say_en.text: Design a homepage for my portfolio site that is unique and stylish.
say_en.note: Claude will first create a design plan, then generate code.

say_en.text: This landing page looks too generic. Redesign it to be more distinctive.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze the current design and propose improvements.
